Multi-CRM Coexistence Mode (Add-On Integration)

No need to disconnect or alter your existing CRM!

⚡ Multi-CRM Supported

💡 Connecting Meta Ads or Google Ads alongside an existing CRM:

  • Meta Business Suite (Direct Access): In Meta Business Suite → Integrations → Leads Access, Meta allows multiple CRMs to be subscribed to the same Lead Forms simultaneously. Your existing CRM will continue working uninterrupted.
  • Zapier / Make / Pabbly (Recommended): In your existing Zap or automation workflow, add an additional Webhook POST Action pointing to our Callback URL below. Both CRMs will receive incoming leads in parallel in real time.
  • Website Lead Forms: Add a secondary asynchronous fetch() POST in your website form submit handler. Your existing database flow remains untouched.
Real-time Lead Ingestion Webhook (Sri Sri Plywoods CRM)

Use the Webhook URL and Secret Key below to connect your Meta Ads Lead Forms, Google Ads, or custom web forms. Every time a customer submits your ad form, the lead is instantly captured into Sri Sri Plywoods CRM with full campaign attribution.

Xilot Automatic Lead Sync is Disabled (OFF)

Xilot se automatic lead ingestion ab band (OFF) kar di gayi hai.
• Manual CRM features (+ Add Client, Import Excel, Pipelines, Call Logs & Recordings) bilkul normal chal rahe hain.

Calling Tools & Telephony Setup Guide

Phone Link ke alternatives: Direct PC Calling, Mobile QR Dialing & Cloud 2-Way Calling

Windows Phone Link se Call kyu nahi lag rahi?
  • Bluetooth Hardware Missing: Phone Link voice call ke liye PC me Bluetooth HFP profile compulsory hoti hai. Zyadatar Desktop PCs me Bluetooth nahi hota.
  • Windows Security Restrictions: Microsoft Windows browser se direct auto-dial allow nahi karta, Phone Link me alag se screen par click maangta hai.
  • Battery Optimization: Android phones (Samsung, Xiaomi, Vivo, Oppo) background me chal rahe Phone Link sync ko kill kar dete hain.

4 Best Working Alternatives (Jo 100% Work Karte Hain)

1. Scan & Dial QR (Instant) Fastest

Call log popup me “Scan & Dial QR” button dabayein. Apne mobile ke camera se scan karein — 1 second me phone ka dialer open ho jayega aur SIM se call lag jayegi!

2. PC Web Softphone No Phone

Phone ki koi zaroorat nahi! PC ke microphone ya headphone se direct browser ke andar se call lagayein. Live timer, mute aur hang-up controls screen par hi milte hain.

3. Cloud 2-Way Calling Enterprise

Exotel, TeleCMO, MCube ya Zadarma gateway se 2-Way Bridged Calling. Server pehle apke phone par ring karega, fir customer ko connect karega. Server par automatic recording save hogi!

4. Mobile Browser CRM PWA

Apne mobile Chrome me CRM open karein. Kisi bhi lead par “Call” dabane par phone ka SIM dialer direct open hota hai bina kisi third-party software ke.
